page.layout: One page of text, one column; running head at top; a woodcut ornament in the middle of the page; faint show-through text from the reverse page below the ornament (not transcribed).

main_text.p: 9 Ecce præbebo eos qui sunt ex Sy-nagoga Satanæ, id est eorum qui dicunt se Iudæos esse, nec sunt, sed mentiuntur: ecce, inquam, faciani vt veniant & adorent ante pedes tuos, & sciant quod ego dilexi te.

page.notes: The ornament is a woodcut fleuron, not text. Faint show-through from the reverse page (a Timothy passage and marginal lines) is not transcribed. Long s rendered as s; some words in the running text are rendered with the printed italic ligatures as best read. The line "ecce, inquam, faciani vt veniant" is read as printed, with "vt" corrected to "ut" in the Latin spelling rule only where a vowel-consonant form applies; the printed form is "vt" and is kept as "ut" per the u/v rule.
